# Plugin refusals: what was written, what VOOL says, what to write instead

<!-- Generated by `python -m tools.creator_docs --write`. Do not edit by hand: change the code, then run it again. -->

Each row is one mistake made to the example plugin's setup file (`.codex-plugin/plugin.json` in `examples/plugins/template`) and checked the way the Add-ons page checks a folder. `python -m tools.plugin_check FOLDER --json` prints the same answer for your folder: `message` is the sentence shown, `where` is the field, `fix` is what to write instead. Rows: 34.

List each host by itself, such as api.example.com: no wildcard (*), no https://, no path, no port, no spaces, at least one dot. |
